app_publication_note: Direct-developer own-WABA Standard Access does not require Advanced Access App Review; Live mode still requires owner confirmation in App Dashboard. Do not switch Live without owner authorization.

business_verification.note: Verification raises limits and Official Business Account eligibility; not a substitute for AI-provider policy eligibility.

ai_assistant_policy.summary: Meta Terms (AI Providers, Jan/Sep 2026) prohibit using WhatsApp Business Platform to offer general-purpose AI assistants as primary functionality except where Meta is legally required to permit that use. Airodrom WhatsApp Conversations V1 (personal AI over WhatsApp) is treated as unresolved/ineligible for production messaging until the owner records an explicit policy determination.
ai_assistant_policy.exact_proposed_use: Authorized WhatsApp Business number as the primary channel for Airodrom general-purpose personal AI (Qwen) conversation replies
ai_assistant_policy.decision: The exact proposed production use is prohibited under Meta AI Providers terms as published (general-purpose AI assistant as primary WhatsApp functionality), except where Meta is legally required to permit that use. Written Meta/legal clarification would be required before treating any exemption as available. Production messaging remains HOLD. Bypass via branding, routing, phone numbers, or account arrangements is forbidden.

official_steps: Choose a dedicated business number not already on consumer WhatsApp (or obtain explicit owner approval before any migration/deletion path)
Add number to production WABA 29094507813569086 in WhatsApp Manager
Verify ownership via SMS or voice code
Register via Cloud API POST /{PHONE_NUMBER_ID}/register with messaging_product=whatsapp and 6-digit two-step PIN
Record production_phone_number_id in Airodrom without overwriting test phone 1330971766772548
Do not enable outbound send from this preparation Mission

stable_https_callback.plan: Owner-provision named DNS hostname + named Cloudflare Tunnel (or equivalent durable reverse proxy) using scripts/whatsapp-webhook-ingress-prep.cjs --production --hostname <stable> --port <control>
stable_https_callback.loopback_host_gate: httpHostHeader rewrite to 127.0.0.1:<port>; Control Center/API/MCP remain private

when_unblocked: Owner lifts HOLD after policy determination
Production phone registered and allowlisted sender configured
Stable HTTPS callback subscribed for production WABA
Send one allowlisted phone-originated text; confirm inbox + conversation turn + Missions unchanged + outbound still OFF unless separately authorized

note: Preparation only. No production messaging, no personal-number migration, no outbound activation, no Mission auto-dispatch.
